{{Top|leg}}
'''Loading bay 8E''' was a [[Hangar/Legends|docking bay]] located in a series of old ruins on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Miser/Legends|Miser]] in the [[Bespin system/Legends|Bespin system]]. [[Elea Poista]], in [[Gender/Legends|her]] persona as the [[Arms dealer/Legends|arms dealer]] "Kel," arranged for a prototype [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]] [[k-43 heavy laser cannon]] to be in the bay, ready for pick-up by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] agents.
